findings.claim: The link limits the supplied prefix to the additive square-class quotient and says the consumer adds multiplicative notation, field-map and cardinality adapters. At the stated programme baseline all three generic adapters are already present, so this is an incomplete import-versus-build boundary. The historical ownership link is valid; treating these generic adapters as remaining consumer implementation invites duplication.
